reference.review_scope: Original three images, questions.json, reference.json only; no method outputs viewed.
reference.verdict: No substantive correction to 18 expected sets, statuses or approximate positions identified.
adjudication_rules: Keep all 18 questions in each method denominator, including runtime/format/missing-case failures.
Distinguish intended textual target understanding from selecting the corresponding occurrence and region.
Whole-line boxes containing the requested word plus protected words fail word-level selection even if the returned text is correct.
Repeated words require distinct one-to-one occurrence regions; duplicated boxes cannot count as separate occurrences.
Treat all reference boxes as approximate AI visual annotations, not human-verified precise ground truth.
Exact/color aggregate mixes lexical matching and color conditions; do not infer causal color perception from it.
Keep first valid model responses with frozen prompts; never repair wrong answers using reference labels.
scope_limits: Three public images, six questions per image.
English board writing with Traditional Chinese instructions.
No training, physical calibration, robot operation or generalization claim.

batch.scope: runner, batch launcher, tests, frozen references, all 36 case decisions and raw outputs; no model rerun
batch.verdict: PASS: no score disagreements or substantive implementation findings after separating content and batch-schema metrics.
notes: Missing A F-Q6 remains in denominator.
B E-Q5 and E-Q6 fail because a repeated occurrence in the upper sentence is missing.
AI visual adjudication is not human acceptance or precise physical wipe validation.

scope: Independently read all 36 second-round raw answers and recorded parser outcomes across 18 questions per route.

Compared content with the unchanged reference, original images previously inspected, OCR candidates and first-round adjudication; repeated words were assessed as distinct occurrences with coarse locations.
Checked the frozen single-question adapter, launcher, baseline manifest and existing test receipt without executing models or rerunning tests.
Recomputed final case counts, category totals, schema counts and all transition lists in adjudication.json and comparison.json against the independently reviewed decisions.

schema_unit_boundary.baseline_unit: One six-question response per image; three calls per route.
schema_unit_boundary.second_round_unit: One independent question per response; eighteen calls per route.
schema_unit_boundary.interpretation: Do not present baseline call-schema rates and second-round call-schema rates as a directly comparable improvement percentage. Grouping six independent calls by image remains a different calling procedure.

scoring_boundaries: Readable malformed answers are content diagnostics only; raw outputs and parser validity were not repaired.
Complete enclosing code fences were permitted by the original parser in both rounds; trailing quotes were not removed.
Distinct repeated-word occurrences must all be selected. VLM E-Q5 now includes both I occurrences and You; E-Q6 still omits the upper-sentence my.
Whole-line regions do not establish successful selection of one requested word. VLM E-Q2 and E-Q3 remain failures despite containing relevant text.
Reference boxes are approximate AI annotations, not human-accepted precise ground truth or physical wiping masks.
Three photos and one greedy run per condition do not establish general superiority, stability or a unique error cause.
